description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the ReportGeneratorDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup procedures, test methods for retrieving display field groups, display fields, and filter fields, and utilizes test data fixtures.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorDaoTest
classes.description: Test class for ReportGeneratorDao, extending KernelTestCase, containing setup and test methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, loads fixture data, and initializes ReportGeneratorDao.

methods.name: testGetDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Tests retrieving all display field groups, asserting the count.

methods.name: testGetAllDisplayFields
methods.description: Tests retrieving all display fields, asserting the count.

methods.name: testGetAllFilterFields
methods.description: Tests retrieving all filter fields, asserting the count.
